summary: Raises a structured exception from a copied 8-dword template: copies the template block from unk_5B9DE0, overwrites the last two slots with the supplied parameters a1 and a2, and calls RaiseException with the template's exception code, flags, argument count and argument pointer.

operations.description: Copy the 8-dword exception template from unk_5B9DE0 into the local exception descriptor buffer.
Overwrite template slots 6 and 7 with the two supplied parameters a1 and a2.
Raise the exception via RaiseException using the template's exception code (slot 0), flags (slot 1), number of arguments (slot 4) and argument pointer (slot 5).

Called by eight exception-throwing wrappers to raise a prepared exception: sub_59A5FE, CThrowWithException, CExceptionThrowWrapper, sub_59AD49, CThrowWithException_ae07, CExceptionThrowWrapper_af17, sub_59AF68, ExceptionThrowWrapper.

unresolved: Which copied template fields act as exception code, flags, argument count and argument pointer is inferred from the RaiseException argument order and is not separately documented in the packet.
The purpose of parameters a1/a2 landing in template slots 6 and 7 is unknown; they are not named by any packet symbol.
